label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: After the New arrivals heading and VIEW ALL link, focus landed on a list item named Black and stayed there. Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrow Right and Home all left focus on the same item, so it acts like a keyboard trap and I could not reach any product.
Product cards in the carousels show only a name and price as plain text. I found no focusable link or button for a product, so I could not open a product page or add to cart with the keyboard.

[name] from the top of the page crosses an accessibility widget button, the cookie notice links and the Decline button before reaching the main content. After Decline was pressed, focus reset to the top of the page, so I had to start tabbing again.
Slide buttons are named Load slide 1 of 3, 2 of 3 and 3 of 3, which does not say what they do. The carousel Previous and Next buttons have no description of what they scroll.

The main navigation (New Arrivals, Men, [name], Sale) was shown on screen but I never reached it by Tab, since the skip link jumped past it and the later Tab order went into the slides and carousel instead.
